func TestScanCoursePlanRestoresResolvedLearningPathForWorkerRetry(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	pathID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	request, err := scanCoursePlan(rowScannerFunc(func(destinations ...any) error {
		*destinations[0].(*string) = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
		*destinations[1].(*string) = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
		*destinations[2].(*string) = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
		*destinations[3].(*string) = "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
		*destinations[4].(*string) = "go.backend"
		*destinations[5].(*sql.NullString) = sql.NullString{String: pathID, Valid: true}
		*destinations[6].(*[]byte) = []byte(`{"source":"STUDENT","reason":"INITIAL","desired_outcome":"Build a Go API","constraints":{},"audit_refs":{}}`)
		*destinations[7].(*domain.CoursePlanStatus) = domain.CoursePlanPlanning
		*destinations[19].(*time.Time) = now
		*destinations[20].(*time.Time) = now
		*destinations[21].(*time.Time) = now
		return nil
	}))
	if err != nil || request.LearningPathID != pathID {
		t.Fatalf("resolved path did not survive repository scan: request=%#v err=%v", request, err)
	}
}

func TestUTCStorageTimestampCanonicalizesPostgresTimestampLocation(t *testing.T) {
	createdAt := time.Date(2026, 9, 6, 0, 0, 0, 1_000, time.FixedZone("postgres-local", 0))
	canonical := utcStorageTimestamp(createdAt)
	if canonical.Location() != time.UTC || !canonical.Equal(createdAt) {
		t.Fatalf("canonical timestamp = %v (%v), want same instant in time.UTC", canonical, canonical.Location())
	}
	binding := domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{
		GoalCode: "first-job", DirectionCode: "backend",
		CourseID:        "9c8df60e-e1ec-4f8a-bc33-0e13e4c05345",
		BindingRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1,
		Active: true, CreatedAt: createdAt,
	}
	var err error
	binding.BindingDigest, err = domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBindingDigest(binding)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("digest binding: %v", err)
	}

	normalized, err := normalizeDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(binding)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalize binding: %v", err)
	}
	if normalized.CreatedAt.Location() != time.UTC || !normalized.CreatedAt.Equal(createdAt) {
		t.Fatalf("created_at = %v (%v), want same instant in time.UTC", normalized.CreatedAt, normalized.CreatedAt.Location())
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticPlanLinkMigrationHasFKIndexAndTeacherCheck(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/014_course_plan_diagnostic_link.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s := string(b)
	for _, want := range []string{"diagnostic_plan_id uuid NULL", "FOREIGN KEY(diagnostic_plan_id) REFERENCES diagnostic_assessment_plan(id)", "idx_course_plan_diagnostic_plan_id", "intent_json->>'source'='TEACHER'", "intent_json->>'reason'='INITIAL'"} {
		if !strings.Contains(s, want) {
			t.Fatalf("missing %s", want)
		}
	}
}

func TestCoursePlanColumnProjectionHasOneDiagnosticPlanIDAtScanTail(t *testing.T) {
	prefixed := prefixedCoursePlanColumns("request")
	if strings.Count(coursePlanColumns, "diagnostic_plan_id") != 1 || strings.Count(prefixed, "diagnostic_plan_id") != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("diagnostic projection must appear exactly once: %s / %s", coursePlanColumns, prefixed)
	}
	if !strings.HasSuffix(coursePlanColumns, "diagnostic_plan_id") || !strings.HasSuffix(prefixed, "request.diagnostic_plan_id") {
		t.Fatal("diagnostic id must be final scan destination")
	}
	columns := splitCoursePlanColumns(coursePlanColumns)
	prefixedColumns := splitCoursePlanColumns(prefixed)
	if len(columns) != 32 || len(prefixedColumns) != len(columns) {
		t.Fatalf("scan projection count = %d/%d, want 32", len(columns), len(prefixedColumns))
	}
	for index := range columns {
		if got := strings.TrimPrefix(prefixedColumns[index], "request."); got != columns[index] {
			t.Fatalf("scan projection[%d] = %q, want %q", index, prefixedColumns[index], columns[index])
		}
	}
}

func splitCoursePlanColumns(input string) []string {
	parts := strings.Split(strings.ReplaceAll(input, "\n", ""), ",")
	for i := range parts {
		parts[i] = strings.TrimSpace(parts[i])
	}
	return parts
}

func TestScanCoursePlanRestoresAndValidatesImmutablePathCommandCheckpoint(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	requestID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	studentID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	pathID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	checkpoint, err := domain.NewLearningPathReplanCheckpoint(domain.CoursePlanRequest{
		ID: requestID, StudentID: studentID, LearningPathID: pathID,
		ResultCode: domain.CoursePlanResultCreated, CourseID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
	}, domain.LearningPathReplan{
		Schema: domain.LearningPathReplanRequestSchema, LearningPathID: pathID,
		PlanningRequestID: requestID, CourseID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "fingerprint-v1",
		PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", ReasonCode: "mastery_replan",
		ReasonSummary: "Retry exact route", ExpectedVersion: 7,
		Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{
			ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
			Status: domain.LearningPathItemReady, Targets: []domain.TargetRef{}, ReasonCode: "first_current_gap",
		}},
	}, now)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	request, err := scanCoursePlan(rowScannerFunc(func(destinations ...any) error {
		*destinations[0].(*string) = requestID
		*destinations[1].(*string) = studentID
		*destinations[2].(*string) = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
		*destinations[3].(*string) = "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
		*destinations[4].(*string) = "go.backend"
		*destinations[5].(*sql.NullString) = sql.NullString{String: pathID, Valid: true}
		*destinations[6].(*[]byte) = []byte(`{"source":"STUDENT","reason":"REPLAN","desired_outcome":"Build a Go API","constraints":{},"audit_refs":{}}`)
		*destinations[7].(*domain.CoursePlanStatus) = domain.CoursePlanPlanning
		*destinations[19].(*time.Time) = now
		*destinations[20].(*time.Time) = now
		*destinations[21].(*time.Time) = now
		*destinations[23].(*sql.NullString) = sql.NullString{String: checkpoint.Command, Valid: true}
		*destinations[24].(*sql.NullInt64) = sql.NullInt64{Int64: checkpoint.ExpectedVersion, Valid: true}
		*destinations[25].(*sql.NullString) = sql.NullString{String: checkpoint.PayloadHash, Valid: true}
		*destinations[26].(*[]byte) = append([]byte(nil), checkpoint.Payload...)
		*destinations[27].(*sql.NullTime) = sql.NullTime{Time: checkpoint.CheckpointedAt, Valid: true}
		*destinations[28].(*sql.NullString) = sql.NullString{String: checkpoint.PlannedResultCode, Valid: true}
		*destinations[29].(*sql.NullString) = sql.NullString{String: checkpoint.PlannedCourseID, Valid: true}
		*destinations[30].(*sql.NullBool) = sql.NullBool{Bool: checkpoint.PlannedReused, Valid: true}
		return nil
	}))
	if err != nil || request.LearningPathCommand == nil ||
		request.LearningPathCommand.PayloadHash != checkpoint.PayloadHash ||
		request.LearningPathCommand.ExpectedVersion != 7 ||
		request.LearningPathCommand.LearningPathID != pathID ||
		request.LearningPathCommand.PlannedResultCode != domain.CoursePlanResultCreated ||
		request.LearningPathCommand.PlannedCourseID != checkpoint.PlannedCourseID || request.CourseID != "" ||
		!json.Valid(request.LearningPathCommand.Payload) {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint did not survive scan: request=%#v err=%v", request, err)
	}
}

func TestPathCommandCheckpointPersistenceIsCompareAndSetAndTerminalRowsRetainAudit(t *testing.T) {
	source, err := os.ReadFile("course_plan.go")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	payload := string(source)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"WHERE id=$1 AND status='PLANNING' AND claim_token=$2 AND learning_path_id IS NOT NULL",
		"path_command_kind=$3 AND path_command_expected_version=$4 AND path_command_hash=$5",
		"path_command_payload=$6::jsonb",
		"path_command_result_code=COALESCE(path_command_result_code,$8)",
		"path_command_course_id=COALESCE(path_command_course_id,NULLIF($9::text,'')::uuid)",
		"claim_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(payload, required) {
			t.Fatalf("checkpoint persistence is missing %q", required)
		}
	}
	for _, functionName := range []string{"func (store Store) Complete(", "func (store Store) Fail("} {
		start := strings.Index(payload, functionName)
		if start < 0 {
			t.Fatalf("missing terminal function %q", functionName)
		}
		end := strings.Index(payload[start+len(functionName):], "\nfunc (")
		if end < 0 {
			end = len(payload)
		} else {
			end += start + len(functionName)
		}
		if strings.Contains(payload[start:end], "path_command_kind=NULL") ||
			strings.Contains(payload[start:end], "path_command_payload=NULL") {
			t.Fatalf("%s clears retained checkpoint audit", functionName)
		}
	}

	migration, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/007_course_plan_path_command_checkpoint.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	migrationSQL := string(migration)
	for _, required := range []string{
		"ck_course_plan_path_command_all_or_none", "path_command_expected_version >= 1",
		"path_command_kind IN ('REPLAN', 'NO_GAP')", "learning_path_id IS NOT NULL",
		"ck_course_plan_path_command_outcome", "copied to public result columns only after confirmed Student success",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(migrationSQL, required) {
			t.Fatalf("checkpoint migration is missing %q", required)
		}
	}
}

func TestCoursePlanOutcomeV2CarriesResolvedLearningPathAndIsReplayStable(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := domain.CoursePlanRequest{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		IdempotencyKey: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "go.backend",
		LearningPathID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", CourseID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		Status: domain.CoursePlanCompleted, ResultCode: domain.CoursePlanResultCreated,
		Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceStudent, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial},
	}
	first, err := newCoursePlanEvent(request, domain.SubjectCoursePlanCompleted, now)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	second, err := newCoursePlanEvent(request, domain.SubjectCoursePlanCompleted, now)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if first.SchemaVersion != domain.CoursePlanEventSchemaV2 || first.EventID != second.EventID ||
		string(first.Payload) != string(second.Payload) {
		t.Fatalf("outcome is not stable v2: first=%#v second=%#v", first, second)
	}
	var envelope domain.EventEnvelope
	if err := json.Unmarshal(first.Payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var data map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(envelope.Data, &data); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if envelope.SchemaVersion != domain.CoursePlanEventSchemaV2 || data["learning_path_id"] != request.LearningPathID {
		t.Fatalf("resolved path missing from outcome: envelope=%#v data=%#v", envelope, data)
	}
}

func TestCoursePlanOutcomeDoesNotExposeRetainedPathCommandCheckpoint(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	request := domain.CoursePlanRequest{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		IdempotencyKey: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "go.backend",
		LearningPathID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Status: domain.CoursePlanFailed,
		FailureCode: domain.CoursePlanFailurePathConflict,
		Intent:      domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceStudent, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonReplan},
		LearningPathCommand: &domain.LearningPathCommandCheckpoint{
			Command: domain.LearningPathCommandReplan, PayloadHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64),
			PlannedResultCode: domain.CoursePlanResultCreated,
			PlannedCourseID:   "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
			Payload:           json.RawMessage(`{"private":"checkpoint"}`),
		},
	}
	event, err := newCoursePlanEvent(request, domain.SubjectCoursePlanFailed, now)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if bytes := string(event.Payload); strings.Contains(bytes, "checkpoint") || strings.Contains(bytes, "payload_hash") ||
		strings.Contains(bytes, "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999") || strings.Contains(bytes, domain.CoursePlanResultCreated) ||
		!strings.Contains(bytes, domain.CoursePlanFailurePathConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("terminal event leaked checkpoint or lost failure code: %s", bytes)
	}
}

func TestCoursePlanOutcomeV2OmitsUnallocatedPathForNoGapInitial(t *testing.T) {
	event, err := newCoursePlanEvent(domain.CoursePlanRequest{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		IdempotencyKey: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", GoalCode: "go.backend",
		Status: domain.CoursePlanCompleted, ResultCode: domain.CoursePlanResultNoGap,
		Intent: domain.PlanningIntent{Source: domain.PlanningSourceStudent, Reason: domain.PlanningReasonInitial},
	}, domain.SubjectCoursePlanCompleted, time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var envelope struct {
		Data map[string]any `json:"data"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, exists := envelope.Data["learning_path_id"]; exists {
		t.Fatalf("unallocated initial no-gap exposed a path: %#v", envelope.Data)
	}
}

type rowScannerFunc func(...any) error

func (function rowScannerFunc) Scan(destinations ...any) error {
	return function(destinations...)
}
